entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: A school of magic atop a basalt mountain in the Valley of Tamingazin, founded by refugees from the College of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Valley of Tamingazin
entities.description: Valley on the Otarian continent surrounded by the Magewall.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Academy destroyed in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Magewall
entities.description: A barrier erected by the Institute preventing entry or exit from the valley.

entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: A member who left to join Tagard Tarngold and was brainwashed.

entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: A king assassinated with Aligarius's involvement.

entities.name: Suderbod
entities.description: Nation whose Hemarch attacked the valley.

events.summary: Refugees from the destroyed College of Lat-Nam found the Institute and later erect the Magewall.
events.quote: The Institute was founded by refugees from the College of Lat-Nam

events.summary: Aligarius Timni leaves the Institute to join Tagard Tarngold in conquering Berimish.
events.quote: Aligarius Timni left the Institute to join Tagard Tarngold in conquering the city of Berimish

events.summary: Brainwashed by Ursal Daleel, Aligarius betrays Tagard and is involved in his assassination and the theft of artifacts including the Magewall Hub.
events.quote: Aligarius betrayed Tagard , was directly involved in the king's assassination

events.summary: Aligarius enables the Suderbod attack on the valley, then flees the mind-control and helps stop the army.
events.quote: Aligarius then enabled the attack on the Valley of Tamingazin
